questions.question: What was the simple average day-ahead price at CAISO's SP15 hub in October 2026, in USD per MWh?
questions.answer: The warehouse does not hold the whole month, so I can only give a partial figure. The simple mean of CAISO's SP15 hub (TH_SP15_GEN-APND) day-ahead price (lmp_dam) is 41.81 USD/MWh over the 543 hourly intervals held (iso_dam_hub_prices, source table). I report this in Pacific time. The held intervals run from 9 am Pacific on 9 October to 11 pm Pacific on 31 October 2026. The 201 hours from 1 to 9 October are missing, so this is not a full-October average. The monthly table cost_of_power_monthly shows 47.56 USD/MWh (da_simple_mean, derived). Its da_hours is 48, so it covers only 48 hours and is not the October figure.

questions.question: What was the median day-ahead basis of all of ERCOT's settlement points to the hub average in October 2026, in USD per MWh?
questions.answer: The median day-ahead basis of all ERCOT settlement points to the hub average (HB_HUBAVG) was 0.3866 USD/MWh for October 2026 (node_basis_summary, variable dam_all_basis_p50, derived table). This covers only 20 days (dam_all_days = 20, node_basis_summary). It is not the whole month. The row is labelled 1 October 2026, and the month is read in Central time.

questions.question: What was the highest hourly demand in ERCOT in the week of Monday 2 to Sunday 8 November 2026 (Central time), in MW?
questions.answer: The table holds only part of that week, so this is not a figure for the whole week. Over the 72 hourly steps it holds, ERCOT's highest hourly demand was 65,888 MW (eia930_all_demand, EIA-930, entity eia930:ERCO, demand_mw). That peak was at 3 pm Central on 2 November 2026. The held steps run from 12 am Central on 2 November to 11 pm Central on 8 November, but 96 hourly steps are missing. The missing run is 2026-11-05T00:00Z to 2026-11-09T00:00Z, so a higher hour in that gap would not show here.

questions.question: What was the average hourly day-ahead price at ERCOT's hub average (HB_HUBAVG) in the week of Monday 2 to Sunday 8 November 2026 (Central time), in USD per MWh?
questions.answer: The warehouse holds only part of that week, so I can't give the full-week average. The day-ahead hourly data for ERCOT HB_HUBAVG (iso_dam_hub_prices, variable spp_dam) ends at 11 pm Central on Friday 6 November 2026. Saturday 7 and Sunday 8 November are missing. Over the 120 hourly prices held, from 12 am Central Monday 2 November to 11 pm Central Friday 6 November, the mean is 39.24 USD/MWh (iso_dam_hub_prices). The derived table iso_trader_daily gives the same figure, 39.24 USD/MWh, as the mean of 5 daily day-ahead means for 2 to 6 November. This is a 5-day figure, not the figure for the whole week.

questions.question: What was the average hourly nuclear generation in the Lower 48 states in the week of Monday 2 to Sunday 8 November 2026 (UTC), in MW?

Those steps run from 2026-11-02T00:00Z to 2026-11-04T23:00Z. The remaining 96 hourly steps, from 2026-11-05T00:00Z to 2026-11-09T00:00Z, are missing.
